baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cognition at word 1 takes the possessed wealth at word 3 as the cause expressed by the causative permanence verb at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: A supposition transfers causal power from the possessor to his possession: accumulated property is imagined to manufacture an enduring state for him.

activation_trace.role: The supposition branch supplies the uncertain mental judgment that launches the causal claim.
The acquiring-and-having branch supplies the possessed stock that is promoted into an agent.
The enduring-state branch supplies the imagined result, while the causative form assigns its production to wealth.

changed_reading.before: He thinks his wealth has made him immortal.
changed_reading.after: He performs a causal misattribution in which possessed stock is treated as a machine for producing duration in its possessor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The reckoning verb at word 1, the countable possession at word 3, and the duration predicate at word 4 form a quantity-to-time sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same mental operation that totals property silently extrapolates the total into lifespan: measurable abundance is mistaken for an increase in duration.

activation_trace.role: The counting-and-accounting branch supplies the quantitative operation behind the judgment.
The wealth branch supplies an inventory capable of being totaled and increased.
The long-lasting-state branch supplies the temporal quantity onto which the property total is projected.

changed_reading.before: Wealth vaguely gives him confidence that he will last.
changed_reading.after: He reads life as a balance sheet, converting a rising property total into an imagined extension of personal time.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A support image latent at word 1 can act through the possessive noun at word 3 upon the staying-and-clinging range of word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Wealth is imagined as enoughness made material: a cushion or prop on which the subject can settle, remain attached, and resist displacement.

activation_trace.role: The sufficiency branch supplies the belief that wealth is enough to answer vulnerability.
The cushioning branch physicalizes that sufficiency as something that props or seats the subject.
The property branch supplies the material converted into the imagined support.
The leaning-and-clinging branch turns permanence into settled attachment rather than abstract endlessness.

changed_reading.before: He expects wealth to grant abstract immortality.
changed_reading.after: He imagines wealth as a sufficient physical and social prop on which he can settle and become immovable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cognition at word 1 can reckon wealth among grounds of standing, while word 4 can image something enduringly fixed upon a person.
baseline_models.mechanism: Possession is converted into visible merit; the subject mistakes an attached badge of rank for a status that cannot decay.

activation_trace.role: The counted-merit branch supplies social worth, including wealth, as a basis of rank.
The possession branch supplies the visible resource from which rank is inferred.
The body-fixed adornment branch supplies the image of status worn as a lasting insignia.

changed_reading.before: He expects biological survival from wealth.
changed_reading.after: He may also mistake wealth-marked prestige, fixed to him like an insignia, for an undying social self.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sentence begins with an uncertain judgment at word 1 and ends with a root whose inventory includes a thought settled inwardly at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The predicate can echo back into the cognition: wealth not only appears to prolong the subject but makes the prolongation-belief lodge and persist inside him.

activation_trace.role: The supposition branch supplies the proposition whose persistence is at issue.
The wealth branch supplies both the proposition's object and the force that repeatedly confirms it.
The inwardly settled-thought branch relocates permanence from lifespan to the durability of the conviction itself.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a mistaken belief about external longevity.
changed_reading.after: It can simultaneously diagnose wealth as having made the longevity-belief itself settle and persist within the subject.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding portrait turns fixed wealth-status into a repeated comparative practice: comprehensive faulting and social pressure lower others so the subject's own rank can feel permanent.

activation_trace.role: The counted-merit branch anchors the changed reading in wealth-based social standing.
The wealth branch supplies the comparative resource whose prestige is being defended.
The fixed-adornment branch lets prestige appear attached to the subject as a durable badge.
The encompassing-whole branch makes the social practice comprehensive rather than occasional.
The branch of attacking people's defects supplies one means of producing downward comparison.
The faulting branch doubles the mechanism and makes disparagement look habitual.

structural_cues: The totalizing modifier and paired agent nouns precede the accumulation and belief sequence.
The two neighboring faulting expressions make social aggression a repeated profile rather than an isolated remark.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comprehensive, repeated faulting plus wealth-based merit; I infer that lowering others is a maintenance mechanism for seemingly durable rank. A live alternative is that the first ayah only identifies the subject's conduct and does not explain his longevity belief.

changed_reading.before: Wealth appears to promise either life or static prestige.
changed_reading.after: He makes wealth feel socially immortal by continually depressing others' standing beneath his own.

context_deltas.mechanism: Physical pressure and pushing images activate the focus's remote cushioning branch: wealth becomes an impact-absorbing buffer that lets the subject press others while imagining himself impossible to dislodge.

activation_trace.role: The cushioning branch supplies the buffer that absorbs pressure and props the subject in place.
The settled-clinging branch converts immortality into resistance to displacement.
The squeezing branch supplies an external force against which the imagined wealth-buffer operates.
The prodding branch turns social harm into force that moves another body.
The pushing branch reinforces a force-field reading of domination and resistance.

structural_cues: The paired actor nouns permit their verbal aggression to be heard as repeated pressure before the focus claim.
The focus's causative ending allows the wealth-buffer to be imagined as producing the subject's immovability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies squeezing, prodding, pushing, cushioning, and clinging; I infer a counterforce relation in which wealth buffers the aggressor and transmits pressure outward. The alternative is a purely verbal-social reading with no material pressure analogy.

changed_reading.before: Wealth is a general comfort that makes him feel secure.
changed_reading.after: Wealth is imagined as a pressure-buffer: it seats him firmly enough to push others and mistake protected position for permanence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering turns scattered assets into one inventory, repeated enumeration stabilizes that inventory as a mental total, and the focus's reckoning projects the total into enduring time.

activation_trace.role: The accounting branch anchors the mental conversion from inventory to predicted duration.
The enduring-state branch supplies the temporal result wrongly inferred from the total.
The gathering branch supplies the first operation, consolidating scattered items into a countable whole.
The wealth branch identifies what is consolidated and measured.
The enumeration branch makes counting an explicit repeated practice rather than a hidden metaphor.
The recurring-time branch supplies the bridge by which repeated totals can masquerade as renewed time.

structural_cues: The immediately preceding sequence moves from consolidation to wealth to intensive enumeration.
The focus then begins with another reckoning term, creating an accounting echo across the ayah boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, wealth, enumeration, recurring time, and enduring duration; I infer that the subject transfers numerical increase into temporal increase. The alternative is that counting merely characterizes hoarding and has no cognitive role in the permanence claim.

changed_reading.before: He has much wealth and therefore feels generally safe.
changed_reading.after: Each recounting rehearses a false equation: a larger, repeatedly refreshed total is treated as a longer, repeatedly refreshed life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hoard is not only gathered; latent fist and fetter images make gathering constrictive. Prepared stock then binds the possessor to maintenance of the stock, activating permanence as clinging rather than freedom from death.

activation_trace.role: The property branch anchors the possessive relation that will be reversed.
The clinging branch allows the supposed gift of permanence to become attachment and inability to leave.
The clenched-hand branch materializes accumulation as a grip rather than neutral collection.
The fetter branch supplies the reversal in which what is brought together also binds.
The repeated wealth branch makes the bond specifically a relation to accumulated property.
The prepared-stock branch adds vigilance and provisioning that keep the possessor servicing the hoard.

structural_cues: The object pronoun on the counting verb closes the action back upon the gathered wealth.
The possessive form in the focus says it is his wealth, while the causative predicate lets that possession act back upon him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grasping, fettering, prepared stock, possession, and clinging; I infer a reversal from owning the hoard to being held by it. The alternative is that the constraint images are remote branches and gathering remains simple acquisition.

changed_reading.before: He owns wealth that will keep him alive.
changed_reading.after: The wealth owns his attention and fixes him to itself; what he calls immortality is the hoard's grip on its keeper.

context_deltas.mechanism: A rare branch-to-branch echo reverses the focus's imagined support: the cushion that props the subject is answered by a cushion cast aside, and the destination then breaks what seemed securely seated.

activation_trace.role: The cushioning branch supplies the wealth-prop on which the baseline subject imagines himself securely seated.
The staying-close branch supplies the subject's expected resistance to removal.
The discarded-cushion branch answers the focus prop with the same object now deprived of supporting status.
The dry-object shattering branch supplies the destructive result after support is withdrawn.

structural_cues: The emphatic passive casting immediately follows the rejection particle and reverses the focus's assignment of agency.
The destination noun follows the casting verb, turning removal into entry into a breaking process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prop-cushion in the focus inventory and a cast-aside cushion in the next ayah's inventory; I infer a deliberate material reversal from being supported to being discarded. The live alternative is accidental branch homonymy with no inter-ayah object continuity.

changed_reading.before: Wealth is the prop that seats him permanently.
changed_reading.after: The imagined prop is itself cast aside, and the supposedly immovable subject is handled like disposable cushioning before being broken.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus grants wealth apparent agency and the subject apparent duration; the next movement makes the subject a thrown object and places him within a process whose branch range includes both shattering and the transient debris of worldly goods.

activation_trace.role: The supposition branch marks the permanence claim as a mentally held estimate vulnerable to reversal.
The wealth branch supplies the supposedly durable possession whose material status is tested.
The permanence branch supplies the state directly contradicted by casting and fragmentation.
The throwing branch reverses the focus's subject-object relation by turning the confident possessor into a handled object.
The fragmentation branch supplies an explicit material opposite to enduring intactness.
The transient-worldly-debris branch lets the accumulated object of confidence join the field of perishability.

structural_cues: A categorical rejection opens the ayah immediately after the subject's supposition.
The switch from an active possessor to an emphatically cast passive patient reverses agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies possession, permanence, throwing, fragmentation, and transient worldly debris; I infer that the hoard and its owner are exposed to the same disposability. The alternative is narrower: only the person is thrown, while wealth is not part of the debris image.

changed_reading.after: The possessor is rendered disposable, while the wealth he treated as durable is redescribed by the destination's branch field as eventual debris.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's self-generated supposition is interrupted by a second-person knowledge question and the repeated breaker. The issue becomes not only a false proposition but a sealed way of knowing that must be opened from outside.

activation_trace.role: The supposition branch supplies a private estimate rather than secured knowledge.
The settled-inner-thought branch makes the error durable as a cognitive enclosure.
The non-dominant knowledge branch supplies the explicit epistemic mode that challenges mere supposition.
The repeated shattering branch makes disclosure capable of breaking the settled calculation, not merely adding information.

structural_cues: A direct epistemic question interrupts the earlier third-person report of private reckoning.
The breaker designation is repeated, delaying resolution while intensifying the challenge to what the subject thinks he knows.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies supposition, inward settlement, knowledge, and shattering; I infer an arrow from externally posed disclosure to rupture of a self-sealed belief. The alternative is that the question only magnifies the unknown punishment and does not diagnose the subject's epistemology.

changed_reading.before: The subject merely holds one factually wrong expectation.
changed_reading.after: His error is a self-enclosed knowledge system: private accounting has settled into certainty and must be shattered by disclosure from beyond it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The accumulated material that was treated as a source of life is placed beside divine fire, illumination, and fuel. Agency shifts away from wealth, while material abundance becomes thinkable as combustible input rather than a reservoir of duration.

activation_trace.role: The acquired-property branch supplies the stored material whose imagined function is reversed.
The enduring-state branch supplies the life-producing function falsely assigned to stored material.
The blazing-fire branch supplies the consuming material process that opposes preservation.
The illumination branch makes the consuming process simultaneously an exposure of the false causal claim.
The worship-and-object-of-worship branch exposes the elevation of wealth by placing divine agency against it.
The fuel-material branch allows accumulated material to be tested as something consumed to sustain another power.

structural_cues: The terse chain names fire, divine attribution, and kindling without returning agency to the wealth.
This follows the explicit rejection and breaking sequence, so it specifies a rival causal system.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accumulated property, divine attribution, fire, illumination, and fuel; I infer a material analogy from hoard to combustible input and an agency transfer away from wealth. A live alternative is that the person alone is exposed to fire and the wealth is not figured as fuel.

changed_reading.before: Stored material is a quasi-divine source that sustains life.
changed_reading.after: The hoard is neither deity nor life-source; under the newly named agency, stored material can be exposed as consumable fuel rather than accumulated time.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reaching-and-inspecting movement toward hearts activates the focus's settled-thought branch. The real persistence produced by wealth may be the immortality equation lodged inwardly, with fire functioning as both inspection and internal ignition.

activation_trace.role: The supposition branch supplies the mental content that later inward penetration can expose.
The thought-settled-in-the-heart branch anchors the changed reading in an inwardly persistent conviction.
The overlooking-and-disclosing branch makes the movement toward hearts an inspection of what is concealed within.
The eager-looking branch adds an appetitive gaze that can also describe the acquisitive attention feeding the belief.
The heart-as-inner-kindling branch fuses the cognitive target with an internal combustion image.

structural_cues: The relative clause directs the previously named fire toward an interior human locus.
The motion crosses from external punishment to inward cognition, matching the focus's opening mental verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies supposition, settled inward thought, inspection, eager looking, and an internally kindled heart; I infer that acquisitive attention fixes the longevity equation and that the fire reveals this fixation. The alternative is a solely somatic description with no return to the focus's cognition.

changed_reading.before: Wealth supposedly makes the body endure.
changed_reading.after: What wealth demonstrably makes endure is an acquisitive immortality-conviction inside the subject, which the later fire reaches, exposes, and ignites.

context_deltas.mechanism: Closure combines with the split root's non-dominant image of a stone store for wealth. The secure hoard-vault becomes the architecture of confinement, so settled possession produces enforced staying rather than protected permanence.

activation_trace.role: The property branch supplies what the subject would place and trust inside secure storage.
The settling-and-clinging branch turns secure residence into an inability to depart.
The dominant sealing branch supplies complete closure around the persons inside.
The non-dominant stone wealth-store branch makes the enclosure uncannily resemble a fortified hoard.

structural_cues: The enclosure is described as closed over the people, reversing the usual protective relation between owner and vault.
The closure follows inward penetration, leaving no outside or inside refuge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wealth, settling, total closure, and a non-dominant stone storehouse specifically for property; I infer an architectural reversal from safe hoard to carceral vault. The alternative is that the storehouse branch is only lexical residue and the closure has no relation to wealth storage.

changed_reading.before: Wealth secures a protected place in which its owner can remain.
changed_reading.after: The protected place turns inside out: the hoard's sealed architecture becomes a prison that makes the owner remain.

context_deltas.mechanism: Supports and extension return the focus's own prop-plus-duration logic inside the closed destination. The wish is not simply denied; it is mirrored in hostile form as supported, lengthened, compulsory abiding.

activation_trace.role: The cushioning-and-propping branch supplies the subject's imagined support structure.
The enduring-state branch supplies the duration the subject wants wealth to cause.
The clinging branch allows desired stability to invert into compulsory attachment to a place.
The structural-support branch relocates propping from wealth to the architecture of confinement.
The adherence branch strengthens the sense of enforced staying within that structure.
The drawn-out length branch supplies spatial extension to the enclosing supports.
The prolonged-term branch activates a temporal extension that can echo the focus's desired duration.

structural_cues: The final locative phrase remains inside the already sealed scene and ends on support plus extension.
Spatial length and temporal prolongation coexist in the final adjective's branch inventory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus prop, permanence, enclosure supports, adherence, spatial length, and prolonged time; I infer an ironic realization in which the desired causal form returns as enforced duration. The alternative is purely spatial: extended pillars describe structure without implying prolonged experience.

changed_reading.before: Wealth will support him and lengthen his secure existence.
changed_reading.after: Support and extension do arrive, but as the architecture and duration of inescapable confinement; the immortality fantasy is mirrored rather than merely canceled.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it chains rare nominal branches for a spider-term, a blind burrowing creature, and a non-dominant stone wealth-store. It remains anchored to the focus's wealth and permanence roots and to the explicit closure cue, but downstream prose should present it only as a cross-domain material analogy, never as a lexical translation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The rare animal branches attach directly to the focus nouns at words 3 and 4, while the later split-root storehouse branch supplies a sealed habitat for their interaction.

activation_trace.role: The reported spider term turns wealth into a web-making image of self-constructed security.
The blind rodent-like creature turns staying into enclosed, sightless burrowing rather than transcendent life.
The containing-enclosure branch supplies a habitat that holds everything within it.
The non-dominant stone wealth-store branch ties the animal enclosure specifically back to hoarded property.

changed_reading.before: Wealth opens an unlimited future for its owner.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, wealth spins and burrows a sealed storage-world whose blindness and enclosure are misfelt as permanence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries both targets of the split knowledge root: the dominant target contributes profuse outflow while the non-dominant target contributes knowing. Both are packet-backed and the result remains anchored to the focus's settled supposition, but prose should qualify the outflow as an image for disclosure, not the direct sense of the contextual verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins supposition to an inwardly settled-thought branch; the later knowledge question and repeated breaker provide a traceable means by which that settlement can be ruptured.

activation_trace.role: The supposition branch supplies the closed mental estimate that disclosure confronts.
The settled-thought branch gives the estimate an inward persistence that must be disturbed.
The dominant split target's profuse-outflow branch images disclosure as pressure released from an external source.
The non-dominant split target's knowledge branch keeps the outflow tied to an actual epistemic cue.
The shattering branch supplies the effect of high-pressure disclosure upon the settled belief.

changed_reading.before: The question simply withholds information about the breaker.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, knowledge arrives like a profuse discharge from beyond the subject's private calculus and bursts the immortality-thought settled within him.

strongest_changes: The preceding gathering and repeated counting make the focus's reckoning a precise conversion of property quantity into imagined personal duration.
Clenched, fettering, and sealed-store images reverse possession: the hoard that should preserve its owner instead binds and encloses him.
The rare cushion branch in the focus is answered by the next ayah's discarded-cushion branch, turning wealth from prop into cast-off support.
The later inward inspection strengthens a psychological reading in which wealth makes the immortality-belief, rather than the body, persist in the heart.
Final support and extension imagery mirrors the original fantasy in hostile form: permanence becomes prolonged, compulsory confinement.
summary.what_was_special: The trace is driven by branch collisions rather than a single resolved interpretation: counting meets recurring time, prop meets discarded cushion, settled thought meets inward ignition, and a split closure root yields both sealing and a stone store for wealth. These activations preserve causal, social, material, psychological, and carceral readings side by side.
remaining_uncertainties: The arrows from social disparagement to rank maintenance and from hoarded wealth to fuel are reader-supplied mechanisms, not explicit packet assertions.
The cushioning, spider, blind-creature, and profuse-outflow activations are deliberately form-distant and should remain exploratory.
The final extension may be only spatial rather than temporal, so the ironic prolonged-abiding reading remains coexistent with an architectural reading.
The non-dominant stone wealth-store branch strongly activates the vault reversal, but closure need not historically or compositionally depend on that branch.
